faq.q: How does local image resizing work?
faq.a: CoolTools loads the image into browser memory, draws it onto an HTML5 Canvas resized to your desired pixel dimensions, and serializes it to local files.

faq.q: Will maintaining aspect ratio distort the image?
faq.a: No. When 'Maintain Aspect Ratio' is checked, updating the width automatically recalculates the height (and vice versa) to prevent layout distortion.
